name: story-brief
title: Draft editorial story brief
for_each: select id,title from stories order by title

sections.title: Recorded performance
sections.sql: select s.start_on,s.end_on,m.views,m.engaged_minutes,s.coverage from metrics m join snapshots s on s.id=m.snapshot_id where m.story_id=$1 order by s.end_on desc

sections.title: Refresh work
sections.sql: select code,description,owner,due_on,status,evidence from actions where story_id=$1 order by due_on

name: editorial-action-register
title: Draft editorial action register
for_each: select id,name from publications order by code

sections.title: Actions
sections.sql: select a.code,s.title,a.description,a.owner,a.due_on,a.status,a.evidence from actions a join stories s on s.id=a.story_id where s.publication_id=$1 order by a.due_on

sections.title: Import windows
sections.sql: select start_on,end_on,timezone,scope,coverage,source_name from snapshots where publication_id=$1 order by end_on desc
